title: September 2024: Citations, web search, and SIS/LMS integrations!
summary: The AI on Flint can now provide in-line citations and search the web for the most up-to-date info! Plus, class rosters can now be imported from your school’s SIS or LMS.
body_markdown:
Flint now supports integrations (via[Edlink](https://ed.link/) ) with the following SIS and LMS systems:


1.


SIS


1.


Veracross


2.


Blackbaud


3.


OneRoster


4.


Powerschool


2.


LMS


1.


Canvas


2.


Schoology


3.


Blackboard


4.


Google


5.


Microsoft


6.


Moodle


By importing class rosters, school admins can dramatically reduce the work needed for teachers to use Flint with their students, as their classes will be automatically set up for them. View the step-by-step guide[here](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/9670956-how-to-import-users-and-groups-as-an-admin-in-flint) .


To read more updates about Flint, check out our[press](https://flintk12.com/) page.
